manage_websocket_lifecycle: manage a websocket connection lifecycle for realtime audio transcription with session management and cleanup
route_realtime_events: route realtime websocket events like session.update, input_audio_buffer.append, and input_audio_buffer.commit to handlers
buffer_audio_chunks: buffer base64-encoded PCM16 audio chunks into an asyncio queue for streaming transcription processing
start_transcription_generation: start an async transcription generation task that streams audio chunks to the vLLM engine and returns deltas
send_transcription_events: send transcription delta and done events with usage stats back to a websocket client
